title: What is Temperature?
description: Temperature is the sampling dial that sets how random a model's next token feels. What low and high settings do, and where builders set it for factual versus creative work.
lead: Temperature scales the model's next-token scores before sampling, deciding whether answers come out steady or surprising. A low setting concentrates probability on the top choice so replies stay deterministic, while a high setting spreads it so rarer tokens surface more often. It changes the style of sampling, never the underlying knowledge, and every product team sets it per task.
